source.name: shadcn/ui components
source.license: MIT (shadcn/ui). Component list from ui.shadcn.com/r/index.json; summaries from each docs page.

items.name: Accordion (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

items.name: Alert (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays a callout for user attention.

items.name: Alert Dialog (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

items.name: Aspect Ratio (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays content within a desired ratio.

items.name: Attachment (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, upload state, and actions.

items.name: Avatar (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

items.name: Badge (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

items.name: Breadcrumb (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

items.name: Bubble (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content.

items.name: Button (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

items.name: Button Group (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.

items.name: Calendar (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A calendar component that allows users to select a date or a range of dates.

items.name: Card (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

items.name: Carousel (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A carousel with motion and swipe built using Embla.

items.name: Chart (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Beautiful charts. Built using Recharts. Copy and paste into your apps.

items.name: Checkbox (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

items.name: Code Block (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays code, terminal output and diffs with an optional header, line numbers and a copy button.

items.name: Collapsible (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.

items.name: Combobox (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.

items.name: Command (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Command menu for search and quick actions.

items.name: Context Menu (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays a menu of actions triggered by a right click.

items.name: Dialog (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.

items.name: Direction (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A provider component that sets the text direction for your application.

items.name: Drawer (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A drawer component for React.

items.name: Dropdown Menu (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by a button.

items.name: Empty (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Use the Empty component to display an empty state.

items.name: Field (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Combine labels, controls, and help text to compose accessible form fields and grouped inputs.

items.name: Form (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Build forms with React and shadcn/ui.

items.name: Hover Card (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.

items.name: Input (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A text input component for forms and user data entry with built-in styling and accessibility features.

items.name: Input Group (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Add addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.

items.name: Input Otp (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Accessible one-time password component with copy-paste functionality.

items.name: Item (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A versatile component for displaying content with media, title, description, and actions.

items.name: Kbd (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Used to display textual user input from keyboard.

items.name: Label (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

items.name: Marker (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labeled separator in a conversation.

items.name: Menubar (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.

items.name: Message (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays a message in a conversation, with optional avatar, header, footer, and alignment.

items.name: Message Scroller (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A chat scroll container that anchors turns, opens saved transcripts, follows streamed responses, loads history without jumping, and jumps to any message.

items.name: Native Select (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A styled native HTML select element with consistent design system integration.

items.name: Navigation Menu (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A collection of links for navigating websites.

items.name: Pagination (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Pagination with page navigation, next and previous links.

items.name: Popover (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

items.name: Progress (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task, typically displayed as a progress bar.

items.name: Questionnaire (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A multi-step questionnaire with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform, and skippable questions.

items.name: Radio Group (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one of the buttons can be checked at a time.

items.name: Resizable (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with keyboard support.

items.name: Scroll Area (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Augments native scroll functionality for custom, cross-browser styling.

items.name: Select (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.

items.name: Separator (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Visually or semantically separates content.

items.name: Sheet (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the main content of the screen.

items.name: Sidebar (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A composable, themeable and customizable sidebar component.

items.name: Skeleton (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.

items.name: Slider (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.

items.name: Sonner (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.

items.name: Spinner (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.

items.name: Switch (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

items.name: Table (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A responsive table component.

items.name: Tabs (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.

items.name: Textarea (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea.

items.name: Toast (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A succinct message that is displayed temporarily.

items.name: Toggle (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A two-state button that can be either on or off.

items.name: Toggle Group (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.

items.name: Tooltip (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

items.name: Trace (shadcn/ui)
items.summary: The building block for reasoning, tool calls, sources and more.
